title: Layout
description: full = title, artist, difficulty, mods, progress, star rating and BPM, plus the difficulty settings row. compact = title, difficulty, progress and one line of star rating and BPM.

title: Original-language titles
description: Show the title and artist in their original script (titleUnicode / artistUnicode) when the map has them.

title: Difficulty settings row
description: Full layout: AR/CS/OD/HP for the ruleset being played (taiko OD/HP, catch AR/CS/HP, mania OD/HP). Mod-adjusted values show the original first: 9→10.33.

title: Zone
description: Where the strip sits. auto: osu!/catch right of the playfield (under score/accuracy), mania left of the stage, taiko below the lane on the left. left/right pick the other side band, side of the stage, or side below the taiko lane.

title: Nudge x / px
description: Moves the strip right (positive) or left (negative) from its zone position, in 1920×1080 px.

title: Nudge y / px
description: Moves the strip down (positive) or up (negative) from its zone position, in 1920×1080 px.

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2. The strip grows away from its anchored edge.

title: Backing
description: none = text floats on the game with a contrast shadow. scrim = a soft dark glow behind the strip that fades out. panel = an 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map = progress, star and rate colour tinted from the map's background (Material 3 tonal spot; grey backgrounds fall back to amber). 18-lab = always amber.

title: Mania ColumnStart override
description: 0 = read from your current skin's skin.ini through vosu (osu!stable default 136 when it can't be read). Set a value to override where the stage's left edge is. lazer centres the stage and ignores this.

title: Mania ColumnWidth override
description: 0 = your skin's per-column widths and spacing from skin.ini (default 30). A value forces one width for every column, with no spacing.

title: 18—LAB tag
description: Show the 18—LAB tag under the progress line.
